purpose: Provide explicit reset-time friction values used by the mass-friction damage-threshold calculation.

default.scope: each Firm task obj_of_interest except Task 0

task_4: unchanged and excluded from the Firm evaluation subset
notes: The directory name is retained for compatibility with existing libero_config_dir paths.
Task 0 preserves the user-configured random mass and friction ranges.
Task 5 retains reset-time mass randomization in [0.08, 0.12] kg.
Damage thresholds are now derived from reset-time mass, static friction, gravity, and tolerance factor.
